name: PIC growing-finishing SID lysine biological response evidence

source.title: Meta-analysis to Determine the Standardized Ileal Digestible Lysine Requirements of Growing-finishing Pigs from 11- to 150-kg

notes: The public 2021 meta-analysis supports the biological SID lysine target used by the PIC programme.
The public article does not publish enough marginal response coefficients to reproduce PIC's economic calculator across arbitrary nutrient densities.
PigFlow must not infer or fit production ADG/FCR response curves from the biological target alone.
Economic optimisation becomes available when a sourced response model supplies predicted ADG and feed efficiency for candidate nutrient densities.
